Manifest.Name: 苦尽甘来-苦行僧购房后仓库恢复 / Hardship Rewarded - Ascetic Storage Restored After Home Purchase
Manifest.Author: fuliezi
Manifest.Description:
仅在苦行僧角色全款购房或还清房贷后，将主仓库从 16×10 恢复为正常的 24×10。保留特性、特性点和其他仓库的原版规则。
Restore ascetic main storage from 16×10 to the normal 24×10 only after buying the property outright or paying off its mortgage. Preserve perks, perk points and vanilla rules for other inventories.
